Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment described in the PRIDE dataset (PXD027282) and the corresponding methods section is a methodology validation study focusing on cell type deconvolution. It compares single-cell line proteomes (controls) against mixtures of those same cell lines (cases) to test the accuracy of deconvolution algorithms. This is a technical/methodological comparison of cellular stoichiometry rather than a biological perturbation (e.g., drug, genetic KO, or disease state) applied to the samples. Therefore, it is mapped as 'un-classified' per the hard rules for non-perturbation studies.
